 Cosmax profit leaps 318% in third quarter
 The Korean cosmetics maker reported third-quarter net profit of 44.5 billion won ($33.4 million), beating market expectations as revenue climbed 49.5 percent.
 Published 
 November 11, 2026 - 3:50 p.m. 
 Make us preferred on Google 
 Beauty products from Cosmax 
 COSMAX 
 Cosmax, a Korean cosmetics company, on Wednesday reported its third quarter net profit of 44.5 billion won ($33.4 million), up a sharp 317.7 percent from a year earlier.
 The company said in a regulatory filing that it posted 83.3 billion won in operating profit for the quarter, compared to 42.7 billion won a year ago. Revenue also rose 49.5 percent to 875.8 billion won.
 The earnings exceeded market expectations. The average estimate of net profit by analysts stood at 42.7 billion won, according to a survey by Yonhap Infomax, the financial data firm of Yonhap News Agency.
